kiosk.title: Government Counter Sign Language Kiosk
kiosk.subtitle: Indian Sign Language (ISL) Assistive Phrase Interface
kiosk.attract_prompt: Touch anywhere or sign 'HELLO / I' to begin
kiosk.please_sign_again: Could not recognize clearly. Please sign again.
kiosk.low_confidence_notice: Unsure of gesture. Would you like to retry or call the clerk?

framing.center_yourself: Please stand inside the guide frame
framing.more_light: Lighting is dim. Please adjust counter lamp.
framing.hands_not_visible: Please keep both hands visible inside the frame.
framing.multiple_people: Multiple people detected. Signer should step forward.

kiosk.privacy_badge: Privacy Verified: No video leaves this kiosk. Landmarks only.

recorder.title: ISL Landmark Dataset Recorder
recorder.consent_body: By participating, you authorize the capture of numerical 3D hand and body skeletal landmarks (coordinates) for training an on-device accessibility kiosk. No video or facial photos are recorded or stored. Your identity is protected by a pseudonymous Signer ID. You may withdraw or discard recordings at any time.
recorder.consent_checkbox: I understand and consent to landmark-only recording
